name: Vibro-ax
description: A vibro-ax, or vibro-axe, was a type of ax that used a compact generator to create vibrations along the cutting edge's surface, which significantly increased the weapon's lethality. There existed one-handed and two-handed models. Similar vibration-based technology could be found in vibro-blades, vibro-knives, vibro-pikes, and vibro-lances.
